title: Lae'zel/Cinematics
html:
Overview Approval Disapproval Banter Location Remarks Romance Cinematics

This page contains a collection of cinematic scripts found in Lae'zel's scenes.

Overview

These cinematic scripts for the cutscenes, which are more akin to written storyboards combined with developers' notes, are included under the 'Expand' buttons below. They are all part of the game files.[1]

Romance

The following full internal script is in the file: CAMP_Laezel_ROM_Romance3_MorningIVB.lsj
Lae'zel appears, leaning over the player's bed with a sincere smile, shaking them awake.

Player stands from their bed and faces Lae'zel. She straightens out and smiles wider. - Player: Is everything all right? Lae'zel reaches down and pulls the player up from their bed by their hand. Fade to black. - Fade back in. Player and Lae'zel sit on the roof of the Elfsong Tavern. The sun is just about to rise.

The camera moves to show the sun beginning to rise over the horizon. Soft light covers the faces of the player and Lae'zel in a beautiful orange glow.

Lae'zel reaches her hand towards the player's.

Lae'zel says nothing but smiles wide. She takes the player's hand and they watch the sun.

Lae'zel's smile fades. She nods, with slight sadness and stands. She walks away, then looks back over her shoulder.

At end of line, Lae'zel stands and walks away, then looks back over her shoulder.

Looking back over her shoulder. Fade to black after line.

Evil Ending

The following full internal script is in the file: END_BrainBattle_FinalDecision_Nested_EvilLaezel.lsj

Lae'zel looks over the awed, kneeling people of the city, Hovering above them - the NETHERBRAIN - still, awaiting her word.

Laezel is looking over a crowd, slowly clenching her fists, psionic energy pulsing from her.

Psionics pulse. Two githyanki warriors, bloodied from battle, rise from the back of the kneeling crowd and loyally join her at her side as an honour guard. Lae'zel then turns her back on the crowds, gazing outwards instead – UPWARDS

WIDE SHOT of a fleet of Nautiloids, hanging eerily suspended in the sky

Lae'zel turns her back on the crowd in front of her by turning to her left, and gazes upwards at the Nautloids hanging in the sky above her

The Nautilods begin to power up, turning their noses outwards. With a gesture, Lae'zel summons a red dragon and mounts it, soaring upwards to join the fleet.

Nautiloids power up and move in the sky. Lae'zel motions with her right hand for the Dragon to descend above her. She looks to her left and glares at Mindlflayers stood off to the side. She then walks forward towards the landed dragon. She approaches the Dragon's right side cheek and runs her hand lovlingly across it, the Dragon rears its head up and she crosses to the other side.

Lae'zel is riding on the back of the Dragon.

Shot facing Lae'zel on dragonback, grim determination on her face as portals begin to snap to life all around her.

Lae'zel raises her arm and makes a pointing gesture forwards to the portals in front of her.

Vlaakith slouched, bored on her throne, examining her nails.

A long room, the edges blurred by shadow. A solitary figure sits the throne at the other end - QUEEN VLAAKITH of the githyanki, looking utterly bored. The camera creeps towards her as she begins to stir herself at some disruption.

Portal opening for Gith to jump into. Portals opening in Vlakkiths room.

[Vlaakith] sits up from her slouched position, Two Githyanki warriors leap through a shimmering portal brandishing weapons. Vklaakith recoils in horror Close-up on Vlaakith's, eyes growing wide with alarm as her face is suddenly awash with the colour of illithid portals.

Vlaakith's expression finally turn to fear - then we CUT TO BLACK.

Vlaaktih recoils in fear on her throne, bringing her hand up to her face to shield herself.

Portal opening for Gith gards to jump out of. Portals opening for Dragons to fly towards. Cut to black.

Notes and references
